description: The recorded EXECUTE AS of a procedure, read where a real account reports it: SHOW PROCEDURES has no execute_as column - it surfaces under DESCRIBE PROCEDURE as the property row 'execute as' (OWNER / CALLER, defaulting to OWNER when the clause is omitted), with the argument-type list mandatory there. The COMMENT lands in SHOW PROCEDURES' description column, and COMMENT before EXECUTE AS parses. Converted 1:1 from features/ExecuteAsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE my_proc() RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL COMMENT = 'owner proc' EXECUTE AS OWNER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'ok'; END $$
SELECT MAX(IFF("property" = 'execute as', "value", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE caller_proc(n INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL COMMENT = 'caller proc' EXECUTE AS CALLER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN n; END $$
SELECT MAX(IFF("property" = 'execute as', "value", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE default_proc() RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'default'; END $$
SELECT MAX(IFF("property" = 'execute as', "value", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE commented_proc() RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL COMMENT = 'my comment' EXECUTE AS OWNER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'hello'; END $$
SELECT MAX(IFF("property" = 'execute as', "value", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
